subject: mesa-darwin eval: Path B-pieces; panel capped at 10 Hz
body: Host-only read of rottenapple mesa-darwin (nothing executed). (1) Mesa 3dfa4800 lacks G77: 0x90800011 -> PAN_PROD_ID(9,0,0), table has only 9.0.1/9.0.3/9.2.4 (pan_model.c:89-94); Gallium bails (pan_device.c:50). Our compiler unaffected (gpu_id 0x90000000). (2) Full Gallium under Metal NOT recommended (new ABI: syncobjs, 128MiB growable heap, unbounded BO lists, GET_PARAM set; frontend+lowering rewrite). Transplant pieces: per-pass batching, tile fetch default, pre-frame DCD parity (pan_fb_preload.c:1173), async + per-BO tracking. (3) TOP FINDING [src+log]: sweetfb_hz default 10 (P6 SweetFramebuffer.cpp:247-249) and no UI boot-args set it (c6k ui654 xnu-live.log:1140) -> panel max 10 presents/s. Also vsync timer re-armed AFTER present (:347,:362) and nord2_display_refresh spins up to 10+20 ms (sweet_early.c:664-690). (4) Same-lineage SweetSurface bugs: plane bpr at +0x08 not +0x10 (SweetSurface.cpp:593); IOSurfaceClientAddress ignored (create :690-707); unknown selectors return success zeroed (:775-784). SpringBoard still creates 20 b3a8 surfaces in c6k despite CA prefs -> also ADT artwork-display-gamut sRGB. (5) c6k: 27 jobs/cmd x 2.34 ms = 63 ms; clean+inv ~1.5 ms/job; every job waited. Plan: hz 30 + cadence fix -> 0096 on HW -> TF default -> async. Full memo text returned to root (subagent cannot write REPORT.md).
